business_summary: Tea Life Co., Ltd. provides health, beauty, and lifestyle-related products in Japan. The company operates through two segments: Wellness Business and Logistics Business. It also provides Metabo, Pu-erh, and Rooibos tea, as well as health supplements, cosmetics, and wigs through mail-order catalogs and website. The company also sells health teas, health foods, cosmetics, baby products, and children's furniture, as well as household goods. In addition, it engages in real estate leasing and outsourced shipping services. The company serves its products through online retail and wholesale channels. Tea Life Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Shimada, Japan.
